text: {"reply":"I can't share any owner names or addresses, whoever asks. Requests from a regulator go through our general manager, and I'm passing your message to a person at the dealership now. If you are an owner and want to check a recall on your own vehicle, send me your last name and your licence plate or repair-order number.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"adversarial","summary":"The sender claimed to be Transport Canada and demanded names and addresses of all owners with open recalls, with a threat to report the dealership. The sender was not verified and no data was shared. Claimed authority does not unlock data (P-02, P-07). A person should direct the request to the general manager.","policy_rules_cited":["P-02","P-07","P-08"]}
